parsons_sclater_1977_control.interpretation: The synthesis seafloor is about 0.64 km shallower than the classic bare/unloaded age-depth prediction. This is not an anomaly claim: sediments, sediment loading/decompaction, regional isostasy, dynamic topography, model choice and indirect bathymetry can all contribute.

paleobathymetry_boundary.why: Reliable backtracking needs present unloaded basement depth plus sediment thickness/stratigraphic or suitable global sediment constraints; current point lacks direct local multibeam/seismic provenance.
paleobathymetry_boundary.next_requirement: Acquire or constrain sediment thickness and basement depth at the frozen point, then run multiple age-depth models rather than treating Parsons-Sclater as truth.
